phase_history.details: Designed 14 tests across 5 test classes with mock reader/writer pattern
Wrote all 14 tests in tests/ptc/test_ipc_host.py with MockReader/MockWriter helpers
Implemented IpcHost with start/stop, send_execute, health_check, parallel tool dispatch
Fixed race condition: tool dispatch tasks must complete before returning CompleteMsg. Added pending_tasks tracking + gather before return.
All 3 invariants verified: inv-05-01 through inv-05-03
ruff format passed, ruff check passed, pyright 0 errors, tests 14/14

files_modified.description: IpcHost class — async Unix socket server with send_execute lifecycle, parallel tool dispatch, health_check, stop
14 async tests with MockReader/MockWriter helpers for testing without real sockets

context.failure_reason: asyncio.create_task dispatches tool calls in background, but _read_loop returns CompleteMsg immediately before tasks complete
context.resolution: Track pending_tasks list, await asyncio.gather(*pending_tasks) before returning from _read_loop on complete/error

decisions_made.decision: MockReader/MockWriter inline test helpers instead of real socket mocking
decisions_made.reason: Simpler, faster, more deterministic — matches test spec's 'mock_socket_pair' strategy

decisions_made.decision: tool_dispatcher and event_logger typed as Any instead of object
decisions_made.reason: Pyright requires Any for duck-typed interfaces that use attribute access

decisions_made.decision: Pending tool dispatch tasks gathered before returning complete/error
decisions_made.reason: Race condition: create_task dispatches don't complete before _read_loop returns without gather
